notes.title: BUG FIX #2
notes.notes:
List of bugs fixed:

- Bug that prevented the player from planting trees.
- Bug in the save that made resources disappear.
- Bug with the boss freezing and not dying during the invasion.
- Visual bug on the character's hand when punching.
- Bug when overlapping a slot.

If you have any bug issues, just write to the Steam community in the pinned post or our discord.

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Combat
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We haven’t gotten the opportunity to show off some combat yet, so here we are - THE COMBAT UPDATE.

Here’s what an enemy camps might look like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/0b755c9dab6e9feff65db42c0cb46cedf394dba7.gif

Of course, different enemies might have different camps, like this one:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/e68b20d4c787bcc5ae378107fb3f5177f4e216b0.gif

Not only do we have enemy camps, but we do have the ability to trap enemies!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/a8ad3c58a9b571a62fd3c3e0cfb3c613864be872.gif

 A new enemy appears! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/1717f68defa9c41ad80ed3676a65d70254e52aed.gif

While we’re here, we’re taking the opportunity to show several different skins that we added recently. Here’s one last one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/0b920f0f3bb00689bb236b8677eebc6894b30fca.gif

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our Discord and follow us on Twitter for more Doomed Land updates.

See you next time!
The dev team

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We’ve implemented cooking and recipes. Here’s a look at a couple recipes in our cooking pot:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/ca33360d84cfa442fc69b72a6a8aa362024d0932.gif

Different recipes call for different ingredients. These recipes will provide certain buffs and HP! What recipe do you see that you’re most excited about? Feel free to let us know in the comments!

We’ve also added a farm animal 🐮
In addition to growing produce on your farm, farm animals will be another important source of ingredients for recipes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/9c56bec0081eeee486ae97101b78448ad8a07b8c.gif

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you!

See you next time!
The dev team

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We’ve implemented a way to skip to the next day in order for you to pass the time as you choose. By sleeping in your bed, you can move onward to the next day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/43f66390a28db701085d73ba266fba53c7eafa00.gif

The passage of time is very important since you only have 7 days before a new boss comes!

Here, you can see the altar. The altar allows you to summon certain monsters, such as the slime you can see below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/84284bfe8f40b4b4f04c969de5492fc57ffe50a3.gif

Remember when we mentioned bosses?
Right.
Well, here’s a sneak peek at one of them - and some spells you can use to defeat them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/66b7a6fa534846c3f4959d3c021b6eff676d53b1.gif

And finally, even heroes need to eat sometimes. You can farm and grow your own food just like this!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/85a459e2d4cd7319cba76d1283331623496dd302.gif

Mmmmm! Fresh produce is sure to help boost your HP 😉

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you! 

See you next time!
